gate: T3 quiet-host re-run -- the compliant measurement the freeze deferred
rendered_from: the completed run's RAW outputs; NOT re-measured (a second run would be a different sample)

blocks_not_rerun.m1: warm per-edit latency -- produces no per-session unchecked count, cannot move T3
blocks_not_rerun.m35: one 120-edit session -- not a per-session sample, cannot move T3

quiescence.bar_basis: the v1.32.0 run that RATIFIED T1-T6 measured 13-32% CPU median with ~385 processes
quiescence.excursion_note: The bar is a MEDIAN bar because the ratification figures are block-boundary medians. Spikes are expected and reported, not hidden: the daemon and PSES doing the work ARE load. The evidence of a QUIET HOST is ZERO competing agent processes and a total process count in the ratification run's range.

t3.target: At most ONE edit per session returns "NOT checked", and only during cold start
t3.target_source: docs/roadmap-ii/SLO-BASELINES.md section 9 (ratified by Mike 2026-08-21; the file is a frozen regression bar)
t3.how_to_read_a_miss: SLO-BASELINES section 9: T3 was ratified with SPREAD ZERO, so its evidence is categorical rather than statistical -- "a T3 or T4 miss is therefore a BEHAVIOURAL regression and should be read as one, not as measurement noise."

comparison_to_the_loaded_freeze_run.reading: Load was a large contributor -- the miss fell from 6 of 15 to 1 of 15 -- but it was NOT the whole cause. The target is categorical, and one session still exceeded it on a quiet host.

also_observed.note: same blocks, recorded because they came free -- NOT a re-litigation of the frozen bar
